checks.name: Delegate memory and inherited lifecycle
checks.evidence: Pinned Tao0.37.2 uses dynamic ClassBuilder parent with auxState pointer and named inherited ivar access. New subclass adds no ivars/new/dealloc, checks equal instance_size, checks returned oldclass. Existing EventLoop IdRef retains the same object. All pinned AppDelegate methods were checked; none uses dynamic self.class().superclass() super-dispatch, avoiding recursive inherited dispatch. TaoApp.sendEvent does, but NSApplication class is not modified.

checks.name: Thread and registration
checks.evidence: MainThreadMarker gates synchronous setup; no application code concurrently mutates delegate isa. AppHandle is held in OnceLock; missing handle returns TerminateCancel. Existing parent shouldTerminate method is rejected rather than silently overridden.

checks.name: Startup ordering
checks.evidence: guard_armed beginsfalse, NativeState.activate sets true only after initialization and activation succeed and before command response. UI registers close listener before activation, blocks native keyboard/pointer and keeps rootinert until response. Later activation failures never disarm guard.

checks.evidence: Frontend actual quit smoke now issues a second runtime/native request while the first dirty/pending dialog remains open, waits for a fresh guard status, asserts exact same dialog and count1, then cancels and checks state/revision/savedRevision/pixels/pending editor.

checks.evidence: smoke_quit requires --smoke/--quit-smoke/isolatedroot and armedsession, never changes allow_close. smoke_result accepts only --smoke before setting intentionalapproval. quit_smoke_report reports without approval.
